hook: 4 products, all under $47, fixed my Costco pantry

scenes.visual_prompt: Before shot: chaotic pantry with tipped oil jugs, slumped bags, loose cans, and a heap of snacks
scenes.voiceover: Two Kirkland oil jugs I couldn't reach, a slumped rice bag, canned goods lost in a dark cabinet, and a pile of loose snacks.

scenes.visual_prompt: Placing oil jug on non-skid lazy Susan turntable and spinning it
scenes.voiceover: Twenty-four ninety-nine got the oil off the back wall — 6,190 reviews, non-skid base.

scenes.visual_prompt: Decanting rice and flour into clear Vtopmart containers with locking lids
scenes.voiceover: Twenty-nine ninety-eight got the bulk bags into airtight, see-through containers — 28,028 reviews backing it up.

scenes.visual_prompt: Pulling out the PXRACK expandable drawer full of canned goods
scenes.voiceover: Forty-six ninety-nine brought the back row of canned goods forward instead of hiding it.

scenes.visual_prompt: Sliding out a fabric storage cube full of loose snacks
scenes.voiceover: And seventeen seventy-two, with 119,574 reviews, caught everything else that didn't have a home.

scenes.visual_prompt: Final wide reveal shot of the fully organized pantry, everything visible and accessible
scenes.voiceover: Four products, every one of them under $47, and I stopped unpacking my whole pantry just to find the oil.

caption: I compared what's actually on the Amazon best-seller charts for a Costco pantry mess — star ratings, review counts, and prices, checkable right now. Four products, all under $47. Full breakdown with the exact reviewer quotes in bio.
